topic: Corpus Construction and Development of a Text Style Identification System for the Kazakh Language Using Machine Learning Methods
research_questions: How do genre, source and length affect five-way functional-style classification?
Do Kazakh-specific and modern multilingual encoders outperform transparent linear baselines on the same frozen inputs?
How does performance change on reserved documents and previously unseen sources?
data_freeze_requirements: Complete checksummed corpus with CSV/metadata alignment and per-source/genre/length counts
Resolve known extraction damage and style conflicts; retain reasoned quarantine
Reserve reference documents, author/work/template/duplicate groups and source-shift sets before training
Report actual retained volume and imbalance; do not fabricate a quota
Freeze exact shared text views and every encoder tokenizer/revision
Publish rights/provenance metadata without claiming blanket redistribution permission
optional_after_primary_results: Kaz-RoBERTa concat4 as a registered ablation; existing v4/v6 results are retained
XLM-R-base if it answers a distinct hypothesis and fits the resource budget
One frozen-prompt local Kazakh LLM comparison; no paid API, test-driven prompt search or model-generated gold labels

experiment_rules.selection: Validation Macro-F1 only; all planned seeds retained; representative seed 42 fixed in advance
experiment_rules.v4_v6_tests: Previously inspected development diagnostics, not fresh final tests
experiment_rules.shared_input: One fixed text view per document for the primary comparison; no silent truncation
experiment_rules.long_document_windows: Separate preregistered secondary analysis; no post-test choice of aggregation
experiment_rules.stop_rule: One compatibility/memory probe, then one frozen primary series; no retraining merely to obtain a preferred score

publication.planned_main_title: Source-Aware Corpus Construction and Functional Style Identification for Kazakh
publication.degree_publication_requirement: Requires confirmation for the current AITU cohort; Scopus-only admission requirement not established by this audit
publication.existing_conference_paper_status: Reported accepted by the author; DOI, proceedings record or acceptance evidence not supplied
publication.submission_rule: One manuscript under review at one venue at a time; use a sequential backup venue after withdrawal/rejection
publication.extension_rule: Cite prior paper, identify new data/methods/results, follow the selected publisher's prior-publication and AI-use policy

reservation.source_shift_scope: Source units excluded from future v7; some sites known to historical models. Not a universally unseen publisher test.

tokenizer_reference.note: Tokenizer snapshot predates the later hardware-compatibility status update; encoder names, revisions and limits are unchanged.
